relations.identityProof: A proposal needs one tenant/case identity spanning entity kind, operation, target or pre-materialization subject, exact deployed contract and current snapshot; no reviewed authority owns that coordinate.
relations.lifecycleProof: Cycle runs orchestrate journeys and command executions track transient delivery, while the case must own draft through submitted, decided and materialized proposal state with optimistic versioning.
relations.cardinalityProof: One cycle may contain multiple entity proposals and one proposal may move through multiple cycle tasks, so neither cycle_run nor cycle_task can be the proposal head.
relations.retentionProof: The current case head must survive command-execution expiry and remain linked to permanent submitted, decision and result snapshots.
relations.implementation: Add one payload-free case head in common document DDL; content remains exclusively in contract-bound snapshots.

relations.identityProof: Case command evidence needs a stable case FK plus expected/before/after case versions and states; generic command execution and audit rows do not carry this enforceable identity.
relations.lifecycleProof: Accepted, rejected and exact-replay outcomes are immutable business evidence, unlike the mutable, expiring event.command_execution processing head.
relations.cardinalityProof: A case has many command outcomes, including rejected attempts and replays, while one idempotency coordinate resolves to one original outcome.
relations.retentionProof: Evidence follows case/legal retention and cannot inherit event.command_execution's 30-day expiry.
relations.implementation: Add an append-only bounded evidence child; continue using event.command_execution for transient command claiming.

relations.identityProof: Searchable findings require case, evaluated snapshot, ruleset release/hash and semantic field path coordinates that snapshots and audit do not index relationally.
relations.lifecycleProof: Findings are append-only observations of an immutable snapshot and must never become a second answer store.
relations.cardinalityProof: One evaluation has bounded many field findings and a case has many evaluations; legacy validation tables duplicate this per request family.
relations.retentionProof: Finding projections follow case retention while full validation input/output remains in the immutable snapshot.
relations.implementation: Add one bounded append-only validation projection and converge domain-specific validation children.

relations.identityProof: A materialization attempt needs case, source snapshot, materializer version, attempt number, expected target version and optional result snapshot as one enforceable coordinate.
relations.lifecycleProof: Requested/running/succeeded/failed attempt state is distinct from both case lifecycle and generic command transport state.
relations.cardinalityProof: A case can have multiple retry attempts but at most one successful outcome for an idempotency fingerprint.
relations.retentionProof: Attempt outcomes and safe support codes remain with the case after transient command execution expires.
relations.implementation: Add a compact attempt projection; member-to-authority mappings belong in snapshot lineage.

relations.identityProof: Snapshot predecessor links cover one aggregate chain but cannot identify cross-snapshot transformations, source members, envelopes or normalized target rows.
relations.lifecycleProof: Lineage is immutable provenance, independent of the mutable case and materialization attempt heads.
relations.cardinalityProof: One source member may produce multiple target authority rows and one target snapshot may derive from multiple source snapshots.
relations.retentionProof: Lineage must have permanent evidence retention aligned with the snapshots it connects.
relations.implementation: Add an append-only lineage edge with bounded roles and optional member/target coordinates.

relations.identityProof: Cycles need typed primary and related subjects before an entity ID exists; cycle_run.data cannot enforce entity, case, external-reference or snapshot identity.
relations.lifecycleProof: Subject association persists across task changes and later binds a pre-materialization reference to an entity without changing journey identity.
relations.cardinalityProof: A cycle can have one primary and multiple role-distinct related subjects, requiring uniqueness by run, role and subject coordinate.
relations.retentionProof: The subject graph follows cycle governance retention and must remain queryable without parsing mutable JSON.
relations.implementation: Add a typed cycle child; do not add a separate journey table.

relations.identityProof: Existing field binding is constrained to one entity field; relation metadata lacks a positioned source surface and immutable contract-slice binding.
relations.lifecycleProof: Composition is authored and released with a surface change set and cannot copy or override the component's semantic contract.
relations.cardinalityProof: A surface section may embed multiple positioned components with explicit one/many cardinality and stable binding keys.
relations.retentionProof: Bindings follow immutable Studio change-set/release history, unlike runtime case data.
relations.implementation: Add a Studio metadata binding child without validation, storage or authority override columns.

relations.identityProof: Authority declarations are release artifacts, not independently authored runtime rows; their identity is the applied release and payload hash already enforced by runtime_meta.applied_release_payload.
relations.lifecycleProof: Stage, activate, supersede and rollback already belong to runtime_meta.applied_release; a second status lifecycle would permit drift.
relations.cardinalityProof: One immutable authority-register artifact per plane/release can contain bounded aggregate entries and be compared with grants, functions and triggers by CI.
relations.retentionProof: Applied release payloads and generated inventories provide immutable deployment history without an additional table.
relations.implementation: Publish an authority_register artifact through runtime_meta.applied_release_payload and extend CI drift checks; reject a governance table.

relations.identityProof: A relationship-level status cannot identify independently governed profile_exchange, sourcing, procurement, invoicing, payments and services-procurement permissions.
relations.lifecycleProof: Each capability needs requested, active, suspended and ended state with its own approvals, effective range and command evidence.
relations.cardinalityProof: One relationship episode has many capability episodes and the same capability may be re-onboarded in non-overlapping effective ranges.
relations.retentionProof: Capability history must survive envelope retention and relationship suspension for bilateral authorization evidence.
relations.implementation: Add an effective-dated relationship child in G3; G1 defines only the accepted contract boundary.
